en.summary: North American profitability supported higher earnings, while international and financing results were weaker. Automotive cash measures have a separate perimeter.
findings: Revenue was $50.015B and net income attributable to stockholders was $3.335B. Adjusted EBIT was $4.106B, versus $3.376B a year ago.
GM North America adjusted EBIT was $3.592B. International adjusted EBIT fell to $28M and GM Financial adjusted EBT was $668M. These measures use different scopes.
Adjusted automotive free cash flow was $5.882B versus $4.201B. This is not consolidated free cash flow. The $20B buyback authorization is multi-year capacity, not completed repurchases.

follow_ups.question: Will growth sustain earnings and cash returns after investment?
follow_ups.update: Monitor demand, expenses, working capital and cash capital purchases.
follow_ups.next_check: Next quarterly disclosure and official supplemental materials.

limitations: A research snapshot of the listed official materials. Official earnings-call text was not collected.
Standalone and cumulative periods are treated separately; cash flows may require adjacent cumulative-period subtraction. Missing values are not zero.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was retained. Unverified numerical guidance is omitted from the guidance table.
